jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Meta (all genders)
jobs.description:
JustPlay is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Meta product domain and help shape the experience that connects our games with the broader JustPlay platform.
 At JustPlay, Meta is the layer between core gameplay and our rewards platform - including progress, rewards, boosters, LiveOps, and the experiences that connect each game to the wider JustPlay ecosystem. The Meta team owns this layer across our full game portfolio, extending platform features into games and building shared, reusable components that can be adopted across multiple titles. This helps us create a consistent player experience and scale new features across the portfolio without rebuilding them game by game.
 In this role, you'll focus on making the JustPlay ecosystem feel seamless for players - identifying where the experience breaks between games and platform, turning those gaps into product opportunities, and setting direction around the solutions that can have the greatest impact on our key metrics. You'll work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, and game teams to align around priorities, make trade-offs, and drive outcomes across the ecosystem.

 What sets this role apart? 
 You'll be building for an entire portfolio of 50+ games, not just a single title. That means thinking in systems, balancing the needs of different games and player journeys, and shaping solutions that can scale across the JustPlay ecosystem.
 
 Job Responsibilities 
 Own the product strategy, priorities, and key results for your area within the Meta domain

 Identify and prioritise high-impact opportunities across the JustPlay ecosystem, balancing player needs, business goals, and technical constraints.

 Drive complex product problems with a high degree of autonomy, from identifying the opportunity through launch, measurement, and iteration

 Collaborate closely with Design, Engineering, Data game teams, and other Product team members to shape solutions, align on priorities, and bring impactful features to life.

 Translate player needs, business goals, and product insights into clear product priorities and solutions

 Manage priorities and trade-offs across multiple initiatives while keeping teams aligned on goals and outcomes

 Design and run experiments to validate hypotheses, measure impact, and continuously improve the product

 Contribute to a strong feedback culture by sharing perspectives openly, challenging ideas constructively, and actively giving and receiving feedback across the Product team
  

 Job Requirements 
 5+ years of Product Management experience within mobile or another B2C digital product, ideally with exposure to mobile games, gamification, loyalty, or rewards products.

 Proven experience owning a product area or domain, including strategy, prioritization, key results, and measurable outcomes

 Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with experience using data to make product decisions and evaluate impact

 Experience working with cross-functional teams, particularly Engineering, Design, and Data

 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn complex challenges into clear product solutions

 Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, balancing priorities and adapting as new information emerges

 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

 Comfortable giving and receiving direct feedback and contributing openly within the Product team

 Excellent English communication skills

 
 Job Benefits 
 Work-Life Balance and Flexibility : Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

 Mental Health Support : Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

 Training & Development : A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply 

 Germany-Based Benefits : 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution

 State-of-the-Art Equipment : Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed

 A Relocation Package : Includes visa support for those who need it

 Berlin Office Perks : Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.

 Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

 Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer. 
 
 About us 
 Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell.

jobs.title: Product Manager (m/f/d) - For Relentlessly Ambitious People
jobs.description:
Your mission This is not a normal job. Please read this part before you read anything else. 
 If you are highly driven, extremely ambitious, and you want to do the work of your life at a company that will change how people get access to new therapies and shared medical knowledge, mama health is the place for you.
 If not, this role is not for you. This is why:

jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Fraud
jobs.description:
Company Description 
 We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 
 
 We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

 Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

 If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

 With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. 
 
 Amsterdam or London | Reports to Senior Director, Product
 
 The opportunity 
 
 Checkout.com helps businesses thrive in the digital economy by making payments work better. Fraud is central to that mission: we need to protect our merchants and Checkout without blocking good customers or adding unnecessary friction.
 
 We are looking for a Group Product Manager to lead the fraud domain across Payment Performance. You will own the strategy for building our fraud engine with real-time models, controls and decisioning capabilities that protect Checkout and the products built on top of it.
 
 The ambition is to build a best-in-class fraud platform: one that performs at the highest level, adapts as fraud changes and works equally well for merchants as it does to protect Checkout. Protecting Checkout from fraud has significant value for the overall payment performance,
 
 This is a portfolio leadership role. You will lead several Product Managers, co-own the Fraud Data Science roadmap and work closely with Engineering, Analytics, Fraud Operations and Design. You will also spend time with some of the world’s most sophisticated merchants to understand their fraud challenges, prove value and shape what we build next.
 
 What you’ll do 
 
 Set the fraud strategy 
 Create one product vision and roadmap across merchant fraud products, real-time decisioning and Checkout-wide protection.

 Decide where we need to close core gaps and where we can build differentiated capabilities that change the basis of competition.

 Balance merchant fraud, Checkout losses, acceptance impact, FDP revenue and operational effort when setting priorities.

 Define how our fraud capabilities should support Enterprise merchants, Platforms, SMBs and other Checkout products as their needs evolve.

 Build a best-in-class fraud platform 
 Improve the performance, coverage and resilience of our real-time fraud decisioning.

 Build products that let merchants choose the right level of control: configure their own protection, act on intelligent recommendations or delegate decisions to Autopilot.

 Build a platform that enables our internal teams to investigate and respond to fraud trends and fraud attacks, then turn this into better protection for Checkout and our merchants

 Strengthen how merchants monitor, explain and improve fraud decisions through better controls, recommendations, alerting and investigation experiences.

 Expand protection against new fraud types using better data, specialized models and faster learning loops.

 Shape Product and Data Science together 
 Co-own the Fraud Data Science roadmap and outcome metrics with the Data Science leader.

 Ensure Product chooses the right problems, customer outcomes and trade-offs while Data Science owns methods, model quality and scientific rigor.

 Connect model performance and platform investment to visible merchant and business outcomes.

 Build the feedback loops between models, merchant products, analytics and operations that allow our protection to keep improving.

 Guide investment toward capabilities that improve fraud performance at scale, not technical progress in isolation.

 Grow the portfolio and its value 
 Own the product economics of the fraud portfolio, including value measurement, investment cases, adoption strategy and input into packaging and pricing.

 Partner with teams across Checkout include Commercial and Product Marketing to turn complex fraud capabilities into a clear merchant proposition.

 Build credible ways to demonstrate the value of our fraud products before and after launch.

 Work with Risk Operations to define clear boundaries, handovers and feedback loops between automated transaction decisions and account-level operations.

 Lead the team 
 Lead, coach and develop Product Managers across the fraud portfolio.

 Give teams clear ownership, goals and decision rights while building a strong shared purpose.

 Create an effective operating model across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Design and Fraud Op

jobs.title: Product Design Lead
jobs.description:
Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.Â 
 We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.Â 
 This is a senior player-coach role. You will lead and develop our product design team while staying close to the work, setting direction, shaping product strategy, prototyping ideas and helping teams ship high-quality experiences.Â 
 You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a leadership trio, influencing decisions across the organisation and helping Fuel50 build products that are simple, trusted and valuable.Â 
 If youâre a strategic design leader who still loves getting close to the work, developing people and shipping real product, weâd love to hear from you!Â 
What you'll do: Lead, manage and coach our product designers, supporting their growth and helping them reach their next level.Â 
 Set and communicate a clear product design vision across Fuel50's skills intelligence, talent mobility and AI-powered experiences, and tell the story of where our products are going in a way that excites customers, colleagues and leadership.Â 
 Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.Â 
 Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.Â 
 Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.Â 
 Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â 
 Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â 
 Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â 
 Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â 
 
What you'll bring: Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â 
 Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.Â 
 Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.Â 
 The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â 
 The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â 
 Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â 
 Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â 
 Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â 
 Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.Â 
 Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.Â 
 An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.Â 
 You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.Â

jobs.title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über DrAnsay 
 DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.
 Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.
 
 Warum es diese Rolle gibt 
 DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.
 Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.
 
 Deine Rolle 
 Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.
 
 Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.
 
 Was du konkret machst 
 Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

 OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

 Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

 Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

 User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

 Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

 Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

 Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren

 

 Das brauchst du 
 Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

 Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

 Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

 Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

 Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

 Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu machen: Roadmaps pflegen, Updates einfordern, Reporting am Laufen halten

 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1), weil du täglich in beiden Sprachen mit Product, Engineering und Leadership arbeitest

jobs.title: Product Manager - Ecommerce Categories (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Product Manager - Categories (h/f/x)

Localisation : Paris, France

Domaine : E-Commerce Solutions — Navigate & Categories

À PROPOS DE DECATHLON & DU DOMAINE E-COMMERCE

Decathlon accélère sa transformation digitale avec pour mission de devenir la plateforme digitale du sport qui permet à nos clients de découvrir notre univers à travers des expériences locales, axées sur le sport et omnicanales.

Notre Mission : Faire bouger les gens à travers le sport pour rendre le bien-être accessible à tous.

En rejoignant ce périmètre, vous travaillerez au sein du domaine E-Commerce Solutions. Nos équipes transforment et déploient la navigation e-commerce mondiale, les arborescences de catalogue ainsi que les moteurs de catégorisation back-end visant à faciliter la découverte et l'accès à la totalité de l'offre Decathlon (produits, services et informations).

REJOIGNEZ LA SQUAD CATEGORIES

Rattaché(e) au Group Product Manager (E-Commerce / Navigate), vous prendrez la responsabilité de la squad Categories. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'une équipe d'ingénierie dédiée (Tech Lead, Senior Software Engineers) et en étroite collaboration avec les UX Researchers, Product Designers, Data Analysts, Sports Digital Merchandisers ainsi que les équipes E-Commerce locales des différents pays.

  • Vision Produit : Favoriser la découverte grâce à une navigation intelligente et évolutive. Nous construisons un parcours de navigation intuitif, automatisé et personnalisé pour permettre à chaque client de trouver plus rapidement ce dont il a besoin et ce qu'il désire.
  • Objectif Cible : Stimuler la conversion globale et générer du chiffre d'affaires incrémental en transformant des arborescences locales fragmentées en une Core Navigation unifiée et performante sur le web et le mobile.

VOS MISSIONS

Vision & Stratégie Produit

  • Définir la vision produit, la stratégie et la roadmap pour l'écosystème Categories & Core Navigation.
  • Piloter et arbitrer les chantiers clés du produit : Core Navigation (standardisation des arborescences au niveau mondial) et les Moteurs de catégorisation au niveau SKU (comme notre moteur de streaming Tesseract).
  • Aligner les parties prenantes (équipes sports centrales, merchandising digital global, équipes pays) autour de modèles opérationnels partagés.

Discovery & Gouvernance

  • Identifier en continu les opportunités utilisateurs, SEO et business via l'analyse de données, des tests utilisateurs et des études de card-sorting.
  • Etablir un processus continue et consistant d'AB test permettant d’affiner les convictions business et identifier les meilleurs opportunité de croissance
  • Concilier la standardisation globale avec la flexibilité nécessaire aux marchés locaux, en assurant la migration fluide des arborescences locales vers les Core Trees globaux.
  • Établir des cadres de décision et des SLA clairs pour la taxonomie globale, la gouvernance SEO et la création de catégories.

Delivery & Alignement Technique

  • Piloter le delivery agile en partenariat étroit avec le Tech Lead et les développeurs de la squad.
  • Prioriser et affiner le backlog (epics, user stories) pour soutenir les flux d'exportation multi-niveaux, les outils d'orchestration de batchs et l'exécution des règles taxonomiques.
  • Superviser les jalons clés de migration pour les pays adoptant le framework Core Navigation sur desktop et mobile.

Data & Performance

  • Définir et suivre les métriques de succès de la navigation, notamment le PDP Reach Rate, le Revenu par Session, le CTR d'utilisation du Menu et la Conversion par Catégorie.
  • Exploiter l'analyse de données pour optimiser la performance des catégories, éliminer les catégories inactives et rationaliser les filtres taxonomiques.
  • Agencer et prioriser le backlog en s’appuyant sur de la data claire et fiable 

Culture & Mindset Produit

  • Incarner un rôle d'ambassadeur de l'excellence produit et des standards de taxonomie au sein du réseau international de Decathlon.
  • Favoriser un environnement de travail collaboratif fondé sur la confiance, la responsabilité et la centricité utilisateur.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

  • Expérience : 3 à 5+ ans d'expérience en tant que Product Manager dans un environnement B2C

jobs.title: Enterprise Product Manager - ElevenCreative
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs
 ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
 We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
 ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

 Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
 
 How we work
 High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 
 What we offer
 Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

 About the role
 We're hiring an Enterprise PM to own the product experience for businesses using ElevenCreative. ElevenCreative helps creators and marketers generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. A growing share of that usage comes from enterprise teams, including brands, agencies, studios, and media companies that roll it out across their organizations.
 You'll own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That covers the admin, permissioning, and governance features large organizations need to deploy ElevenCreative across teams, as well as the enterprise products we're building on top of the platform, like our Ads Engine. You'll work directly with sales and customers to understand what's blocking deals and adoption, scope and define the big bets, and ship them.
 PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward go-to-market or customer work, and you'll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for enterprise teams.
 
 What you'll do

 Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.
 Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.
 Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.
 Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.
 At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you. 

About the role: 
 We’re looking for a hands-on and strategically minded Product Manager to take the reins of our assistant surfaces and agent harness at DeepJudge. You’ll play a critical role in shaping the present and future of our platform by driving immediate impact across our go-to-market priorities while also thinking deeply about where we go next.
 This is an opportunity to lead product in a high-caliber environment where you're empowered to innovate, move fast, and deliver real value to legal professionals at some of the most sophisticated law firms and legal departments in the world. This is an on-site role based in Zurich. You will report to the Head of Product.
 We’re not building another AI wrapper. We’re building a product with real depth, differentiated by data access, search engine expertise, and deep customer understanding. Chat is quickly becoming the interface of choice, and we’re now moving towards long-horizon agentic tasks – right at the cutting edge of what’s proven in the market. We’re looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is energized by the opportunity to create, and knows how to “cook from scratch” — not just follow the norm . 
 
 Your responsibilities will include:

 Work directly with engineering leads to define and ship high-quality features fast

 Collaborate with Design and Product Marketing to craft delightful and intuitive user experiences

 Engage deeply with customers and prospects to gather insights, validate ideas, and translate feedback into roadmap priorities – combining direct feedback with scaled usage analysis to understand how our products are used, and sharing those learnings across the organization

 Lead cross-functional initiatives that drive adoption, engagement, and measurable value for our users

 You're a great fit if you:

 Have hands-on experience building and shipping agentic applications and RAG systems – going beyond basic chatbot or AI workflow features

 Have a deep understanding of agent evaluation techniques and have built or evolved evaluation datasets and processes before

 Are familiar with the latest agentic AI trends and concepts – and keep following them

 Are humble, curious, and opinionated in the right ways —

jobs.title: Associate Product Owner
jobs.description:
TL;DR Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

 Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

 The problem you'll be solving A corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
 GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.

 What we're looking for You have personally written the tickets. 
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
 You are technical enough to argue with engineers. 
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
 You can write. 
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
 You write specs worth acting on. 
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
 You know what looks good. 
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
 You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide. 
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
 You want to be coached hard. 
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
 You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day. 
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
 You want the scope to grow. 
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.

 What you'll do Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday. 
 Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies
 Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting
 Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue
 Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped
 Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients
 
 What you'll be scoping over your first year: 
 Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on.
 Public REST APIs and MCP servers , so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us.
 AI embedded across the product , inside the surfaces people already work in.
 Workflow automation inside the platform , so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself.
 You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room.
This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor.

 Requirements 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets
 Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation
 Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc
 Nice to have: B2B enterprise SaaS background
 Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows
 Notion fluency
 
 Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on.

 How we hire Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps.
 Intro call: a quick chat to see if there's a match
 Interview with the PM, including a brief intro

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
What we do At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.
 Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.
 Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.
 After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.
 If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.

 What you'll be doing You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.
 You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.
 We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.
 We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.
 Own the wealth product area end to end 
 Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
 Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
 Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
 Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it
 Turn the data into something users act on 
 Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
 Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
 Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway
 Own the numbers 
 Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
 Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
 Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you
 

 What we are looking for You might be a fit if: 
 You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
 You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
 You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
 You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
 Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
 You're fluent in English; German is a plus
 You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany
 That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 
 Strong plus if you have: 
 PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
 Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
 Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
 Subscription and paywall experime

 Project leadership:
 Manage the AIT project, providing guidance, motivation and strategic direction.

 Coordinate the integration of spacecraft subsystems, software, ground support equipment and associated facilities.

 Plan and manage functional, performance, environmental and mission-level testing.

 Ensure that test results, anomalies and verification evidence are properly reviewed and closed.

 Facility and resource management:

 Develop and manage the AIT budget, resource plan and external-service requirements.

 Develop and maintain a detailed AIT schedule with clear milestones, dependencies and schedule margin.

 Monitor progress and identify delays, resource conflicts and critical-path risks early.

 Lead recovery plans when supplier, technical or operational issues affect the program.

 Collaboration and communication:
 Coordinate cross-functional teams, including engineering, manufacturing, quality, safety and external partners.

 Provide clear and transparent reporting to the Chief Program Officer and program stakeholders.

 Establish clear decision-making and change-control processes with customers and suppliers.

 Risk, quality and safety:
 Identify and assess AIT risks, developing mitigation and contingency plans.

 In collaboration with Quality and Safety, manage non-conformances, deviations, waivers, anomalies and corrective actions.

 Ensure that hardware, software, AIT documentation, procedures, readiness reviews, test configurations remain properly controlled and traceable.

 Define clear AIT acceptance criteria and deliverables for suppliers.

 Lead supplier recovery actions when technical mistakes or late deliveries threaten the schedule or mission.

 
 What we would love to see from you
 Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering or a related discipline.

jobs.title: Self-Serve Product Manager - ElevenCreative
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs
 ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
 We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
 ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

 Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
 
 How we work
 High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 
 What we offer
 Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

 About the role
 We're hiring a Self-Serve PM to own the core ElevenCreative product experience for creators and marketers who sign up, subscribe, and build on their own. Self-serve users make up the majority of ElevenCreative's user base, and they use the platform to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
 You'll own self-serve revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That includes how users discover what ElevenCreative can do, how they move from a first generation into agents, video, and multi-step creative workflows, and what keeps them coming back and upgrading. There's no shortage of things we could build. The job is defining the big bets, scoping them well, and shipping them quickly with the team.
 PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward growth or go-to-market work, and you'll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for its users.
 
 What you'll do
 Own self-serve revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, pulling on product, pricing, onboarding, lifecycle, and go-to-market levers to drive results

 Scope and define the big bets for the self-serve product across image, video, music, agents, and editing workflows

 Find the biggest opportunities in the user journey through product data and user behavior, and turn them into clearly scoped projects

 Drive adoption of newer experiences like agents and video, helping users expand from a single product into the full platform

 Work with engineering and design to ship quickly, mocking up early concepts yourself when it speeds things up

 Partner with growth, lifecycle, and social teams on launches and the moments that bring users into new parts of the product

 Define success metrics for your area and track activation, engagement, retention, and conversion to paid plans

 Talk to creators and marketers regularly to understand how they work and where the product falls short, and bring those insights back to the team

 
 Requirements
 5+ years of product management experience on consumer or self-serve products

 A track record of owning revenue, growth, or adoption outcomes and driving the

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Project Manager / Consultant (German required)
jobs.description:
Location: Hybrid, Zürich (2-3 days in office) 
 
 About what. AG 
 We're a Zurich-based digital consultancy with 40+ ambitious, kind specialists. We build websites, digital products and growth strategies powered by data and AI, for clients from innovative startups to global brands. Learn more at what.digital . 

 The role: You take a business-first, data-driven view of what's holding a client's growth back, use AI to diagnose it faster and deeper than a traditional audit, and turn it into a concrete plan that works. It's a long-term role with variety, autonomy, support and a clear path to grow. 

 How we work: You own your growth, and we give you the space to work on yourself. We deliver first-class help to our clients, from start to finish. We focus on real results, not just activity. And we think like entrepreneurs: when we build for clients, everyone wins - our clients, what. and you. 

 
 What you'll do: 
 Be the main point of contact for your clients and build long-term relationships - you think about their business, not just their campaigns. 

 Implement growth strategies across SEO/GEO, paid ads, email, social and more, using AI with the team. 

 Coordinate specialists to deliver great work on time and on budget, with high standards and honest feedback. 

 Run data and AI-assisted analyses to find growth opportunities and turn them into business cases and new projects. 

 Keep an eye on budgets and billing, with support from our finance team. 

 Optional: lead the specialist team, including team happiness and recruiting. 

 
 Key & Essential Skills: 
 Ideally 7+ years in a performance agency (not media buying), including 3+ years leading a team of 3+. 

 Deep knowledge of at least 3 marketing channels (e.g. SEO, Google Ads, Meta, content), with CHF 1M+ in total managed budget. 

 Proven record in client strategy, sales and building data-driven business cases that clients invest in. 

 Native-level German, understanding of Swiss German, fluent English. 

 Comfortable using AI as a core tool for analysis, reporting and consulting. 

 
 What makes you a fit: 
 You like taking ownership and seeing things through. 

 You give honest feedback, to clients and to us. 

 You know when to plan carefully, when to perfect, and when to move fast. 

 You think like an entrepreneur: curious, commercially minded, always moving forward. 

 
 Perks: 
 Beautiful office in Seefeld, Zurich. 

 You'll have real responsibility and influence - and a team that has your back. If you see something that could be improved, speak up - we're listening. 

 Flexible hours and a flat hierarchy - we're results-oriented and don't micromanage. 

 A multicultural team that learns together, including daily hands-on work with AI tools like Claude. 

 25 days holiday plus public holidays. 

 Fair compensation and profit participation. 

 Personal development opportunities, e.g. in 2026 we sent 10 people to Tony Robbins' UPW event. 

 
 How to Apply: 
 Apply via our website with your CV and a 2-3 min intro video in German (e.g. Loom or YouTube): tell us what attracted you to this role and share an example where you helped a client grow or improved something at work. 

 👉 Applications without a video or sent via other channels (e.g. email or social media) won't be considered.

Role description As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.
 
 You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track.  
 
 This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on. 

 Your Mission Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.
 Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success  
 Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead. 
 Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees. 
 Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables. 
 Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods. 
 

 Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
 Several years of experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with full ownership from initiation to closure. 
 Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating conflicting interests across departments. 
 Strong analytical and problem solving skills. 
 Experience taking over or stabilising projects already in progress. 
 Ability to work independently, propose solutions and make decisions within your remit. 
 Business-level communication skills in German and English (C1). 
 Experience in applying common project management tools, e.g. for task and milestone tracking. 
 

 Preferred Qualifications Experience with an ERP or comparable large-scale system implementation.
 IPMA Level C or equivalent. A higher level is a plus. 
 Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment. 
 Experience developing project management standards, templates or training formats. 
 Experience with Jira and Confluence. 
 Experience working in an international, multi-site organisation.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Project Manager is a client-facing role at the center of everything we do.

 Running high-impact A/B tests requires coordination across many disciplinesâresearch, strategy, design, copywriting, development, QA, analytics, and client stakeholders. Your job is to keep everything moving forward, aligned, and energized.

 Key Responsibilities

 Youâll own three core responsibilities:

 
 Coordination . Youâll manage cross-functional teams of 5â10 people and ensure tests move smoothly from idea â build â launch â analysis. Youâll spot risks early, unblock teams, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

 Strategy & Planning. Youâll help build and maintain a testing roadmap of 10â20 upcoming experiments. Youâll communicate the âwhyâ behind the plan, set expectations, and walk clients through progress and results in weekly meetings.

 Energy (âVibesâ). Youâre the main point of contact for clients and internal teams. You bring clarity, positivity, and momentum. When things get busy or complicated, you keep people focused and motivated.

 
 Skills, Knowledge and Traits

 You do not need prior A/B testing experience or even formal project management experience. We will train you. Hereâs what we need from you:

 
 Organization and diligence. You like systems, checklists, and timelines. You front-load work, plan ahead, and donât stop until things are finished properly.

 Communication. You default to over-communication. You proactively reach out to clients and teammates, flag risks early, and ask for help when you need it.

 Smart and high agency. You learn quickly, enjoy technology and design, and want to understand why things work (or donât. Youâre the kind of person who notices patterns and asks good questions.

 
 What Youâll Get

 
 Clear promotion opportunities. We invest heavily in training and promote almost exclusively from within. Most leaders at Spiralyze started in entry-level roles.

 Tech reimbursement. Need a better computer, monitor, or setup? Want training on Figma or GA4? Weâll help.

 In-demand skills. Youâll learn Conversion Rate Optimization from the most experienced experimentation teams in the world.

 Time to recharge. 20 days of paid vacation plus holidays.

 
 If youâre excited about working with smart people, solving real problems, and growing fast in a merit-based environment, weâd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely 
 Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.
 Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.
 Why this role? 
  
 As a Staff Product Manager in Snyk's Agent Security division, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping how modern organizations build and secure AI applications at scale. You'll join a collaborative, forward-thinking team and help drive our mission to embed security into every part of the AI-native development lifecycle. This is a unique opportunity to shape early-stage products from the ground up, operating with the agility of a startup while leveraging the scale of an industry leader.
 
 What You’ll Do 
 Lead new product discovery from idea to execution by partnering with engineers, designers, and customers to identify high-potential opportunities in AI security and beyond.

 Validate problem-solution fit by designing lean experiments and MVPs to quickly validate customer problems and solution approaches.

 Shape the vision and roadmap for the capabilities that you own, balancing short-term experiments with long-term strategic bets.

 Influence the broader innovation agenda by presenting roadmap and strategy to customers, leadership, and internal stakeholders.

 Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to take new ideas from concept to product-market fit.

 
 What You Bring 
 You have solid experience in technology, with strong experience in a product management role.

 You bring a strong technical background and the ability to engage deeply with engineering and AI/ML concepts.

 You are comfortable with high ambiguity and can design frameworks to execute effectively in fast-moving, uncertain environments.

 You have a proven track record of taking early-stage products from concept to launch within SaaS or developer tooling.

 You have strong communication and storytelling skills to influence across teams, leadership, and customers.

 
 It’d Be Awesome If You Also… 
 Have hands-on experience in developer security, AI/ML products, or agentic systems.

 Contribute to open-source or developer communities.

 Have a background in software engineering or have worked in a startup or internal incubator environment.

 Love solving complex problems with a collaborative team.

 Bring fresh ideas and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.

 About Snyk 
 Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.
 
 Equal Employment Opportunity 
 Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: Tech Lead, Android Core Product - Zurich, Switzerland
jobs.description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

With the growth of our Android app, being the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, we find the need for a Senior Android Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push us forward.   

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week. 

What You’ll Do

  • Owning major features and working closely with our design team - take ownership of features inside the app and become responsible of delivering high quality features
  • Shape the future of our Android team
  • Own, maintain and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Participate in discussions across different teams - Product, Design, Engineering
  • Review pull requests, and support other teammates
  • Handle critical issues or cope with unexpected challenges 
  • Take ownership of feature releases and provide nightly builds for the QA team

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Familiarity with Android components
  • Experience building or contributing to at least one Android app
  • Product design intuition and user empathy
  • Drive to push the boundaries of Android UI/UX
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing tests
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase above and beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Rock solid experience with Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android Animations, Jetpack Navigation, JUnit tests
  • Excellent communication skills
  • User oriented problem solving approach
  • Driven with continuous feedback from leaders

Bonus:

  • Experience building, maintaining, or otherwise contributing to open source projects in Android
  • Experience with iOS, Web or NodeJS

Technologies we use:

  • Kotlin
  • Kotlin Coroutines
  • Kotlin Flow
  • Jetpack Navigation
  • Dagger 2
  • Room
  • Custom Views, Canvas & Paint
  • Jetpack Compose
  • JUnit

  • An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, an

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
jobs.description:
Description Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes. 
 You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind. 

 Your mission 1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence  
 Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution. 

 Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy. 

 Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters. 

 Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 

 2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership  
 Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer. 

 Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). 

 Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice. 

 Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos. 

 3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement  
 Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation. 

 Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations. 

 Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder. 

 What We Want to Achieve Together 
 In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds. 
 In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount. 

 Your profile Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies. 

 Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences. 

 Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility. 

 Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data. 

 AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new. 

 A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough. 

 Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both. 

 

 Why us? Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else. 

 A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI. 

 Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites. 

 Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation. 

 Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority.

 Meet the team in the office. 

 Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team!

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner | Integrations (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.

In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.

We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.

This role is technical, but you won't be writing the code

You'll design API surfaces, debate OAuth and webhook patterns, and hold your own with senior engineers and external partner teams. The engineers write the code. Your job is to read it when needed, sketch API designs, argue technical trade-offs, and make sure what we ship is well architected. An engineering background, or serious hands-on coding experience, is what gets you that credibility.

Location & work mode

Berlin-based, minimum 3 days a week in-office, up to 2 days optional home office. We build better in the same room. Decisions happen faster, products ship faster, and the team stays sharper. EU work permit required.

What you'll do

  • Own integrations, the public API, and webhooks end-to-end: strategy, spec, build, launch, measure
  • Build the tools that turn our AI agents from clever responders into systems that close loops: agent to CRM, agent to appointment, agent to handover, agent to custom workflow
  • Stay close to customers and partners every week, in direct calls, by talking to CS, sales, and BD, and by digging into the data yourself
  • Embed with 4 to 6 engineers, set the metric, and own whether it moves
  • Treat the public API and webhooks as a product, with proper DX, docs, and a real roadmap
  • Make integration setup something a customer completes in minutes, alone, without a CSM walking them through it
  • Own quality. Engineers test as they build, you give the final go before anything ships
  • Own the launch and the awareness that follows. There is no product marketing team. You drive positioning, the in-product moments, and the keynote for the big launches, with marketing and sales behind you
  • Work across squads with the AI and Core PMs on the surfaces that touch each other

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years experience in Product Management in B2B SaaS
  • Background in Software Engineering 
  • A track record of shipping things people actually use
  • Engineering background or strong hands-on coding experience
  • Exceptional product and operational judgement
  • Fluent in OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, retries, and API versioning. Tool-calling and function-calling patterns a strong plus
  • Shameless customer obsession
  • Extreme clarity in writing and thinking
  • Speed without sloppiness
  • Low ego and a builder's instinct

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful VSOP at a profitable, growing company
  • Modern Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg
  • Direct work with the founders and a real seat at the product table
  • A team that ships fast and doesn't drown in process
  • 26 days of paid vacation, plus 2 extra

 Since our launch on GitHub in 2021, we have gained trust among thousands of companies seeking secure and seamless solutions for connecting remote employees and infrastructure. By replacing traditional centralized VPNs, NetBird has become a trusted choice for modern network security, connecting today hundreds of thousands of users and machines worldwide. Our open-source, community-driven approach has been a key driver of our success. We listen to our users, and their input helps us make network security better for everyone.

 As a Technical Product Owner at NetBird, you'll be the link between our users and our engineering team on the core NetBird platform. That means the clients, the dashboard and API, and the self-hosted setup. Today our CTO covers product next to running engineering, and you'll take over a big part of the day to day.  Close the loop with the people who gave feedback, so they know what happened with it.

 Spot patterns across feedback and bring them into roadmap discussions, backed by data where you can.

🌟 Position: Risk Manager – Major Infrastructure Project
 📍 Location: 2 days on site (London) 3 days remote
💼 Type: Full-time
📅 Start Date: Immediate
 We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Risk Manager to join our Project Controls team and play a key role supporting one of the UK’s largest and most complex infrastructure programmes.
 Working as part of a major capital delivery environment, you will be responsible for supporting the effective identification, assessment and management of project risks across a complex programme of work. You will work closely with Project Controls, Planning, Commercial, Cost and Project Management teams to provide robust risk insight and help ensure that project decisions are informed by a clear understanding of uncertainty and exposure.
 This is a project risk-focused role , rather than an enterprise or corporate risk position. The successful candidate will have strong experience of quantitative risk analysis, QSRA, cost and schedule risk analysis and project risk modelling , ideally gained within major construction, infrastructure, engineering or other complex capital programmes.
 
 About us
 CMR is first and foremost a team of people, passionate about the construction industry and changing the way project controls is provided.
 We are a progressive and dynamic consultancy offering tailored project controls services across a range of industries.
 Our Purpose (Why we exist): Inspiring new ways to help shape our construction industry.
 Our Ambition (What we want to achieve): Re-imagine project controls through a digital lens, being the obvious choice for clients and the place to grow together with intention.
 🔹 What’s in it for you?
 At CMR you will have the opportunity to professionally develop like nowhere you have worked before.

 If you demonstrate the capability, our merit-based system will enable you to develop quickly.

 We use our in-house capability matrix to transparently track your progression and highlight development areas.

 Join our small, dynamic team where every member has the chance to make a significant impact, shaping the future direction of our company and making a real difference.

 We believe in rewarding our team for their achievements, celebrating our successes but equally helping each other when things are tough.

 The opportunity to work on a major, nationally significant infrastructure programme , gaining exposure to some of the most complex project risk challenges in the UK.

 🔹 You’ll
 Lead and support the implementation of project risk management processes across complex infrastructure and construction projects.

 Own and maintain project risk registers, ensuring risks are clearly defined in terms of causes, events, impacts, probability, consequence and mitigation actions .

 Facilitate risk identification and review workshops with Project Management, Planning, Commercial, Engineering and other project stakeholders.

 Challenge project teams to ensure risks are appropriately identified, assessed, quantified and actively managed.

 Undertake and support Quantitative Schedule Risk Analysis (QSRA) and Quantitative Cost Risk Analysis (QCRA) to assess the potential impact of uncertainty on project outcomes.

 Develop and maintain risk models , incorporating cost and schedule uncertainty, risk events, correlations and appropriate probability distributions.

 Support the development and review of risk allowances, contingency and management reserves , ensuring these are supported by robust quantitative analysis.

 Analyse project cost and schedule exposure and provide insight into P-values, confidence levels, ranges and potential outcomes .

 Integrate risk information with project cost and schedule data to provide a consolidated view of project exposure.

 Work closely with Planning and Project Controls teams to understand the relationship between risk, uncertainty, programme and critical path .
