jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Salesforce & Internal Enablement (all genders)
jobs.description:
Responsibilities We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome’s core business operations for our next phase of growth. 

 Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network. 

 At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain. 

 As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business. 

 As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem. 
 You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities. 
 You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems. 
 You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability. 
 You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly. 
 You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption. 
 You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes. 
 

 Skills Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus). 
 Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics. 
 Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools. 
 Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels. 
 Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation. 
 Business fluency in both  English and German  is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff.  
 

 What we offer Hybrid Work // Stay flexible:  We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries. 

 Room to grow // Stay curious:  In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development. 

 Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active:  We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching. 

 Taking responsibility // We #care:  We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.

jobs.title: Head of Product & Technology (AI) (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Auf einen Blick Arbeitsort:  deutschlandweit oder in einem unserer Büros in München und Berlin
 Arbeitsmodell:  Remote deutschlandweit und zusätzlich bis zu drei Monate pro Jahr innerhalb Europas.
 Arbeitszeit:  Vollzeit  
 Vertragsart:  unbefristete Festanstellung
 Vergütung:  120.000 - 150.000 Euro brutto pro Jahr auf Vollzeitbasis. Die konkrete Einordnung innerhalb der Spanne richtet sich nach relevanter Berufserfahrung, nachgewiesener fachlicher Tiefe und dem Umfang vergleichbarer Verantwortung.

 Warum gibt es diese Stelle? PIABO entwickelt eine eigene Softwareplattform, die internes Wissen und Abläufe für die Teams nutzbar macht. Erste Anwendungen sind bereits im Einsatz. Unser Anspruch ist, daraus ein verlässliches Produktportfolio zu entwickeln: Lösungen, die im Arbeitsalltag genutzt werden, einen nachvollziehbaren Nutzen stiften und sich bei belegter Wirkung für weitere Teams, Kundenprojekte oder neue Angebote eignen.

Damit diese Entwicklung gelingt, braucht es klare Entscheidungen darüber, welche Probleme Priorität haben und welche Lösungen verlässlich in den Einsatz kommen. Die Rolle verbindet Produkt- und Technologieentwicklung, gibt dem bestehenden fünfköpfigen Team aus Development und Project Management eine gemeinsame Richtung und verantwortet zugleich PIABOs operative IT- und Tool-Landschaft.

 Drei Must-haves für die Stelle Produkt- und Business-Urteil:  Du verbindest Produktentscheidungen mit konkretem Geschäftsnutzen.
 Hands-on Engineering: Du bringst eigene Entwicklungserfahrung mit und beurteilst technische Qualität praktisch.
 Führung und operative Verantwortung:  Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Führung und einen verlässlichen IT-Betrieb.
 

 Was du bei uns tust und wie Portfolio und Priorisierung: Du berätst die Geschäftsführung zu Produkt- und Technologieentscheidungen. Du bewertest Vorhaben nach Geschäftswirkung, Machbarkeit, Risiken und Kapazität und übersetzt priorisierte Themen in realistische Umsetzungsetappen. Wenn Nutzen oder Voraussetzungen nicht tragen, machst du das transparent und empfiehlst Alternativen.
 Use Cases und Erfolgskriterien:  Gemeinsam mit den nutzenden Teams nimmst du konkrete Abläufe und Probleme auf, grenzt den Bedarf ein und legst fest, welchen Nutzen die Lösung schaffen soll und woran erfolgreiche Nutzung erkennbar wird.
 Software entwickeln:  Du baust selbst Prototypen und produktive Software mit AI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen, darunter Coding Agents und LLM-APIs. Du testest Annahmen früh und führst tragfähige Lösungen in den produktiven Einsatz.
 Technische Qualität sichern: Du verantwortest technische Konzepte und Qualitätsmaßstäbe: von Architektur, APIs, Datenflüssen und Integrationen bis zu Tests, Code-Reviews, Dokumentation und Übergabe in den Betrieb.
 Team führen und entwickeln:  Du führst das fünfköpfige Team aus Development und Project Management disziplinarisch. Du setzt gemeinsame Prioritäten und Qualitätsmaßstäbe, gibst Feedback und entwickelst Zusammenarbeit und fachliche Stärke weiter.
 Einführung und Wirkung nachhalten:  Du begleitest die Einführung in den nutzenden Teams und prüfst anhand der vereinbarten Erfolgssignale und Rückmeldungen, ob die Lösung im Alltag genutzt wird und den erwarteten Nutzen liefert. Daraus leitest du ab, was weiterentwickelt, skaliert oder beendet wird.
 Operative IT verantworten:  Du verantwortest PIABOs operative IT- und Tool-Landschaft und koordinierst die zuständigen internen und externen Spezialist:innen. Du hältst Zuständigkeiten für verlässlichen Betrieb, Zugriffe, Security und Datenschutz klar und sorgst dafür, dass Fragen mit der nötigen Expertise bearbeitet werden.
 

 Das bringst du mit Die folgenden Erfahrungen sind für die Rolle erforderlich; unterschiedliche Karrierewege können passen: Du bringst mindestens zehn Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Software- und Produktentwicklung sowie mehrere Jahre eigene Entwicklungspraxis mit – zum Beispiel mit Node.js/TypeScript, Python oder Go. Du hast produktive Systeme selbst gebaut und betrieben.
 Du arbeitest täglich mit Coding Agents und LLM-APIs (Agentic Engineering) und kannst ihre Leistungsfähigkeit und Grenzen einschätzen.
 Du hast mindestens ein digitales Produkt von der Idee bis in den Betrieb verantwortet. An einem konkreten Beispiel kannst du zeigen, wie du bei offenen Anforderungen Vision, Roadmap und Prioritäten festgelegt, die Lösung in produktive Nutzung gebracht und anhand messbarer Ergebnisse die nächsten Schritte gesteuert hast.
 Du hast ein Team disziplinarisch geführt und Mitarbeitende fachlich weiterentwickelt. Du arbeitest mit Geschäftsführung, Projektmanagement und Development auf Augenhöhe und challengst Anforderungen, wenn sie nicht zum Ziel beitragen.
 Du hast den IT-Betrieb selbst verantwortet oder eng gesteuert – einschließlich Security, Zugriffsmanagement und Datenschutz.
 Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (C1) und sehr gut Englisch (B2).
 

 Das ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss Du hast als CTO oder CPO in einem Startup gearbeitet oder ei

jobs.title: Enterprise Product Manager - ElevenCreative
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs
 ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
 We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
 ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

 Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
 
 How we work
 High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 
 What we offer
 Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

 About the role
 We're hiring an Enterprise PM to own the product experience for businesses using ElevenCreative. ElevenCreative helps creators and marketers generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. A growing share of that usage comes from enterprise teams, including brands, agencies, studios, and media companies that roll it out across their organizations.
 You'll own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That covers the admin, permissioning, and governance features large organizations need to deploy ElevenCreative across teams, as well as the enterprise products we're building on top of the platform, like our Ads Engine. You'll work directly with sales and customers to understand what's blocking deals and adoption, scope and define the big bets, and ship them.
 PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward go-to-market or customer work, and you'll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for enterprise teams.
 
 What you'll do
 Own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, pulling on product, pricing, packaging, go-to-market, and customer levers to drive results

 Scope and define the big bets for enterprise, from discovery through launch and adoption

 Build the admin and governance layer enterprises need, including role-based permissions, visibility into who has access to what, usage and spend controls, and reporting across teams

 Partner with engineering to scope and ship enterprise products like Ads Engine, turning complex customer workflows into products that scale beyond a single account

 Work with sales to triage feature requests and deal blockers, prioritize across them, and close the gap between what customers need and what we ship

 Join customer conversations to understand how enterprise teams evaluate, buy, and roll out creative tooling, and bring those insights back into the roadmap

 Define success metrics for enterprise features and track adoption, expansion, and retention across accounts

 Work closely with engineering, design, sales, and growth to ship quickly and drive projects all the way through

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
About 1st Formations 
 At 1st Formations, we empower entrepreneurs to start, run, and grow their businesses with confidence.
 Running a business shouldn’t be slowed down by company formation, statutory compliance, accounting, or payroll. From day one, these essentials should be seamless, reliable, and intelligently handled — freeing founders to focus on building and scaling.
 We’re a leading UK provider of company formation and compliance services, building a modern, fully integrated technology platform that supports founders at every stage of their journey. Our platform brings together formation, compliance, accounting, payroll, and ongoing business support in one cohesive experience.
 No stitched-together services. 
No legacy workflows disguised as software.
 Just a single, scalable platform built for ambitious founders who want to move fast, stay compliant, and grow with confidence.
 
 Why Join Us Now? 
 You’ll be joining a business with strong momentum, clear direction, and real opportunity for progression.
 £18m annual revenue, including £9m ARR

 Over 1 million companies formed

 Certified B Corp and Carbon Neutral Business

 Forecast to grow 5x–10x over the next three years

 
 The Role 
 As Product Owner (Data & Delivery), you'll own one product area end to end, from requirement through to released, accepted and measured. Working to the Senior Product Manager, you'll turn agreed outcomes into well-shaped requirements, a prioritised backlog and released changes that work for customers, operations and commercial teams.
 The role is data-led. You'll define the measures that matter for your area, query the data yourself rather than waiting to be told what it shows, and work with our Data and Analytics Lead to turn data needs into clear specifications. Quality is part of the job too: you'll own business acceptance, defect triage and release readiness, with changes you specified accepted by our Product Quality Analyst, and theirs by you. You'll also play a significant part in our platform migration programme, covering requirements, scoping, prototyping and testing.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own delivery of your product workstreams end to end, from refined requirement to release and post-release review.

 Turn outcomes set by the Senior Product Manager or CPO into clear epics, user stories and acceptance criteria.

 Own and prioritise the backlog, running refinement, planning and review with engineering and design.

 Manage dependencies and risks, and keep operations, support and commercial teams informed on scope and timing.

 Define success measures, baselines and targets for each workstream before build starts.

 Query data directly to size problems, test assumptions and challenge analytical outputs before they're relied on.

 Analyse funnels, cohorts and drop-off to find where journeys fail and where the commercial opportunity sits.

 Design and interpret A/B tests, and specify tracking for every change so it's measurable from release.

 Own reporting for your area, recommending whether to iterate, scale or stop after release.

 Shape and test platform migration work, including requirements, data mapping, prototyping, reconciliation and dry runs.

 Own business acceptance, defect triage and release readiness, accepting the Product Quality Analyst's changes and having yours accepted by them.

 Validate end-to-end customer journeys, including compliance-sensitive steps, and make sure each release has the documentation the business needs.

 
 What We Are Looking For 
 5+ years' experience as a Product Owner, Product Analyst or in Product Operations within a digital product environment, including time owning delivery of a workstream rather than supporting one.

 Strong hands-on data skills, including writing your own SQL and working confidently with large datasets, so you can answer your own questions and form a view from the data.

 Sound analytical judgement: you separate signal from noise, recognise when a number isn't reliable, and say so.

 Experience using funnel, cohort and retention analysis to change what a team builds.

 Experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, including sample sizing and an honest reading of inconclusive results.

 Experience defining tracking and event requirements, using tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or GA4.

 Confidence writing clear, testable user stories and acceptance criteria, and running refinement with engineering in an Agile team using tools such as Linear, Jira or Asana.

 Experience of business or user acceptance testing (BAT/UAT), validating end-to-end customer journeys across web platforms, and holding the line on readiness before release.

 The ability to take a defined outcome and run it to delivery, making sound trade-offs between value, effort, risk and dependency.

 Commercial awareness of how product changes affect conversion, revenue, cost to serve and operational load.

jobs.title: Head of Product Design
jobs.description:
🚀 Why Midnite? 
 Midnite is a next-generation sports betting and gaming platform built for a new wave of players.
 We combine sharp product thinking, bold brand, and fast execution to create experiences that feel modern, intuitive, and built for how people actually play today.
 Over 400,000 players have already made the move, and we’re only just getting started.
 We’re a high-performance team operating at pace. High ownership. Constant iteration. No hiding behind processes. We move quickly, test relentlessly, and turn ambitious ideas into real impact. If you’re driven, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments where you can shape meaningful outcomes - keep reading.
 Not your grandad’s bookie.
 👀 The Role 
 Title: Head of Product Design
 Team: Design
 Location: Remote, UK
 Experience quality is one of the clearest ways Midnite differentiates in a category that too often settles for functional and familiar. As Head of Product Design, you will ensure craft, quality and ambition remain central to how we build, as we scale. You will lead Product Design, shape company wide experience direction, and embed Design in the most important product decisions. This is a role with real influence, accountable for how Midnite feels across every surface and responsible for raising the bar as we grow.
 You will: 
 Lead and develop our Product Design team, line managing five designers and setting a clear standard for craft, judgement and ownership.

 Define and uphold the experience bar across all product surfaces, from customer facing native and web to back office platforms.

 Ensure coherence across squads and journeys so Midnite feels like one joined up system rather than a collection of features.

 Shape the long term experience direction and codify principles that guide teams toward a shared north star.

 Mature and drive adoption of our design systems to enable both speed and consistency at scale.

 Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership on strategy, early problem framing and complex trade offs.

 Contribute hands on to Midnite’s most complex and high impact initiatives, elevating outcomes through strong visual and interaction design.

 Collaborate with Brand, Creative, Growth, CRM and Games to ensure the end to end customer experience is cohesive and well crafted.

 Explore and integrate emerging technologies, including AI, where they meaningfully improve how we design and build.

 Strengthen the structures and standards that allow experience quality to scale as the company grows

 The next Midniter: 
 Sets and defends a high bar for visual and interaction design, with exceptional taste and strong product instincts.

 Has operated at scale, shaping design direction across multiple teams and surfaces.

 Has built or matured design systems that improve consistency and enable teams to move faster without sacrificing quality.

 Brings hands on craft capability and is comfortable directly contributing to high stakes initiatives.

 Is a trusted strategic partner to Product and Engineering leaders, contributing meaningfully to roadmap direction and key decisions.

 Develops designers through thoughtful feedback, coaching and hiring, steadily raising overall team capability.

 Communicates clearly and practically, influencing across disciplines and levels of seniority.

 Is curious about emerging technologies, including AI, and thoughtful about where they add real value.

 Cares deeply about building well designed digital products, from simplifying complex systems to refining interaction, motion and hierarchy.

 💰 Winnings 
 Private health insurance with zero excess, including optical cover and optional dental.

 Income protection to protect your earnings and give you peace of mind.

 Tenure holiday policy. After three years you receive an extra two days leave, increasing to 30 days annually after five years.

 Flexible working and a fully supported home office setup so you can do your best work from home.

 Nursery salary sacrifice scheme helping parents save thousands each year on nursery fees.

 Salary sacrifice schemes for tech and holidays so you can spread the cost of the things you want.

 Retail discounts and subscription perks across a wide range of brands.

 Quarterly team socials to connect, celebrate and have fun together.

 At Midnite, we are committed to creating equal opportunities for everyone. We actively strive to build balanced teams that reflect the diversity of our communities, including ethnic minorities, people with disabilities, the LGBTQIA+ community, and all genders.

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead the planning and delivery of complex propulsion projects. You will coordinate multidisciplinary teams and drive projects from requirements definition through design, manufacture, testing, qualification, and delivery.
 This role is suited to someone with proven experience delivering projects in defence, space, rocketry, missile programmes, or another technically demanding aerospace environment. You will work closely with propulsion, chemistry, manufacturing, test, systems, quality, and operations teams to deliver reliable hardware safely and efficiently.

 About us 
 We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defence applications.
 We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.
 We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.
 To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

 Key responsibilities 
 Own propulsion projects from initial requirements through design, manufacture, testing, qualification, and delivery.

 Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering scope, schedule, resources, dependencies, and milestones.

 Coordinate teams across propulsion, chemistry, manufacturing, testing, systems, quality, procurement, and operations.

 Manage project risks, technical issues, interfaces, decisions, actions, and changes.

 Facilitate design reviews, readiness reviews, project reviews, and other programme gates.

 Provide clear project reporting and help improve project-management processes as the company grows.

 What we are looking for 
 Proven experience managing and delivering complex projects in defence, space, rocketry, missile programmes, aerospace, or a similar engineering environment.

 Experience taking projects from requirements or concept definition through development, testing, qualification, and delivery.

 Experience coordinating multidisciplinary technical teams and managing cross-functional interfaces.

 Strong skills in project planning, schedule management, risk management, dependency tracking, and delivery control.

 Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to bring structure to ambiguous or fast-changing situations.

 A degree in engineering, science, project management, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may also be relevant.

 Desirable experience 
 Managing propulsion projects, solid rocket motor development, or other complex aerospace hardware programmes.

 Static-fire testing, flight qualification, launch campaigns, or other high-consequence test activities.

 Missile, defence, spacecraft, launch-vehicle, or other regulated programme delivery.

 Taking hardware from development into repeatable manufacture, production, or operational deployment.

 Systems engineering, configuration management, verification and validation, or qualification processes.

 Explosives licensing, range safety, hazardous-materials controls, or supplier and subcontractor management.

 Benefits and important information: 
 We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent. 

 Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success. 

 Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

 Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

 Free access to shared company housing

 Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (all gender)
jobs.description:
Job description Who we are  
Millions of people live with urological and gynecological conditions they nevertalk about. We are here to end that silence. Kranus Health is a digital therapeutics platform running in several countries across urology and gynecology. Our newest therapy, Kranus Mictera, treats urinary incontinence in women, a condition that affects one in three women and that almost no onetakes seriously. Our therapies are built together with leading clinicians and scientists, prescribed by doctors, and reimbursed by health insurers, whichmeans everything you ship reaches patients with a real diagnosis instead of a wellness audience. We are ~50 people, everyone here owns outcomes ratherthan tickets, and AI is a settled part of how we work, so you won't be stuck in 2022 tooling here. One platform, many therapies, 3 countries. Small team. Big impact. If you live and breathe change, you will feel at home here.

 The Role 
As our Product Manager in charge of our consumer-facing Digital Therapeutics, you will lead the way to transform our platform of therapies from good to first-class with taste. This is not a feature-shipping role. We want someone who thinks in user journeys, obsesses over behavior change, and can tell the difference between a product that works and one that genuinely moves patients forward.

 Your responsibilities Therapy ownership:  You own the full patient journey end-to-end – from the moment a doctor prescribes the therapy, through onboarding and the active therapy phase, to the point where patients feel a real difference and stay. AI is part of the work and part of the product – but it's a means to an end, not the goal itself. 
 Behavior & retention:  You apply proven knowledge of habit loops, nudges, feedback systems, and engagement mechanics to drive sustainable usage. 
 Mobile ownership: You own our therapy apps across urology and gynecology end-to-end. 
 App Store excellence: You treat ratings, store presence, and ASO as core product levers, and actively optimize the funnel from impression to activation.
 

 YOUR TOOLKIT Mobile expertise:  Hands-on product management experience with consumer mobile apps. 
 Platform fluency:  You understand the technical realities of iOS and Android and know how to work with them – not around them. 
 Data & AI fluency: You use AI to move fast, know when it's hallucinating, and back every decision with analytics and experiments, because you own the outcome.
  Languages:  Fluent in German and English.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
About the role:

At the heart of our offering is a versatile software platform for orchestrating complex robotic systems, from industrial robot arms and mobile manipulators to humanoids. Our Forward Deployed engineers bring it into real production environments with international customers and delivery partners.

As Senior Project Manager, you help steer that work. You keep projects on track from POC to production, give team leads a clear picture to decide which projects to take on, and ensure that what we build for one customer flows back into the platform. You work at the staff level alongside product management and technical leadership, and take on whatever else the department needs as it grows. Expect a fast-moving environment where the processes are still being shaped, and you help shape them.

Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the Forward Deployed project landscape, and prepare prioritization decisions with the team leads by strategic value, technical risk, and commercial return
  • Plan scope, milestones, and engineer allocation together with the team leads, and make the trade-offs visible when capacity is tight
  • Drive engagements from POC through pilot to production, including on-site commissioning and acceptance
  • Act as a key point of contact for customers and delivery partners, with a clear interface between their scope and ours
  • Support Sales and Pre-Sales with feasibility assessments and effort estimates
  • Coordinate across product teams and AI research without direct line authority
  • Make sure features built for customer projects are fed back into the platform as standard capabilities
  • Set up lightweight ways of working for planning and reporting that fit how the teams actually work

Essential Skills:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Mechatronics, Electrical, Mechanical or Industrial Engineering, or a comparable field
  • 5+ years of project management, including meaningful time in a startup, scale-up or other fast-growing tech environment
  • Experience with customer-facing projects in robotics, AI or software-heavy automation, and with taking new technology from pilot to production
  • Comfortable with immature products and changing requirements: you make progress without waiting for perfect specs
  • Solid technical understanding of robotic systems and how mechanics, controls, software and AI work together
  • Pragmatic, agile-first project management, with tools such as Jira and Confluence
  • Ability to lead through influence and make trade-offs under ambiguity
  • Fluent English; willingness to travel around 30% of the time, including on-site customer phases

Beneficial Skills:

  • Fluent German; Mandarin is a plus
  • Experience in a product company where customer projects drive platform development
  • Experience with humanoid or mobile robot deployments
  • Familiarity with machinery and functional safety (ISO 10218, ISO/TS 15066, ISO 3691-4)

 

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly. 

This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender

 Du sprichst Zielkonflikte früh an und führst Entscheidungen herbei.

 Als Senior berätst du Kunden bis auf Führungsebene, führst größere oder strategische Projekte, bist fest in Angebote und Pitches eingebunden und unterstützt andere Kolleginnen und Kollegen mit deiner Erfahrung.
 Dein Profil
 Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Beratung, Projektmanagement oder Product Ownership bei technischen Digitalprojekten, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder Beratung.
 Erfahrung mit Projekten in Commerce, Daten oder KI. Erfahrung mit agentischen Lösungen ist ein Plus.
 Du denkst in Kennzahlen des Kunden und kannst Fachbereichen erklären, was eine technische Entscheidung für ihr Geschäft bedeutet.

 Erfahrung mit Workshops auf Fachbereichs- oder Führungsebene ist ein Plus.
 Sehr gutes Deutsch (mindestens C1) und gutes Englisch.
 Was dich erwartet
 Projekte mit Händlern und Herstellern auf einem modernen Composable-Stack, mit Partnern wie commercetools, Snowflake und weiteren.
 Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und kurze Entscheidungswege.
 Austausch mit anderen Consultants, Project Managern und Product Ownern im Team.
 Ein klarer Weg vom Project Manager zum Senior, mit der Möglichkeit, dich in Discovery, Pitches und Beratung einzubringen.
 Weiterbildung ist bei uns fest vorgesehen: Du schlägst Konferenzen, Kurse oder Zertifizierungen vor, und wir planen sie gemeinsam ein.
 KI-Werkzeuge und moderne Hardware als selbstverständlicher Teil der Arbeit.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager – Integrations & Connectors (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission
 Construction companies run their tenders across many tools. Your mission is to make Cosuno the place where it all comes together. Tenders should flow into Cosuno automatically from the systems our customers already use, and results should flow back out without anyone lifting a finger. The deeper Cosuno sits in our customers' processes, the more value we create for them.
 At the same time, AI assistants like Claude and Gemini are becoming how people work. You'll launch our first MCP server so that our customers can analyze their data and operate Cosuno straight from their AI assistant.
 

 How you'll get there: 
 Get to know our customers. Your first weeks are all about listening. You'll talk to customers and find out what it takes for our REST API and connectors to become part of their daily work. Together with Engineering, Customer Success and Sales, you'll turn those insights into a clear roadmap. You'll also set up the tracking that shows how much of our customers' work flows in through integrations.

 Launch the first API improvements and our first MCP server. You'll shape both, write the engineering tickets and roll them out to our first pilot customers, all within your first few months.

 Decide what comes next. Once real usage data and pilot feedback come in, you'll make clear recommendations on what to build and decide on the way forward together with our CTO and Head of Product.

 Make integrations the norm. By the end of your first year, far more of our customers will run Cosuno connected to the tools they rely on, and you'll be the one who made it happen.

 It's an ambitious plan, and that's what makes it fun: you'll see the impact of your work directly in our customers' day-to-day.
 
 How we work: 
 Full ownership: You own integrations end to end, from the first customer conversation to the shipped feature. Engineering takes care of the implementation.

 Close to the customer: You'll talk to customers constantly, mostly remotely, sometimes on-site across Germany.

 Technical by nature: You'll read API docs, test endpoints yourself and discuss data models with engineers. You don't write production code.

 AI-first: We use AI deeply in our product and in our daily work, and we expect you to do the same.
 

 What you bring: 
 You've shaped an API from the product side. You've defined, together with customers and engineering, what a public API or integration of a SaaS product exposes: endpoints, data models, auth, permissions.

 You're technical enough to go deep with engineers. Webhooks vs. polling, pagination, rate limits, OAuth: you can discuss trade-offs, and you test APIs yourself.

 You find the real need. You've worked directly with customers, separated what they ask for from what they really need, and found what it takes for them to use an integration.

 You write tickets engineers love. Clear scope, clear acceptance criteria, and a clear line on what's out of scope. You prioritize by impact, not by who shouts loudest.

 You're fast. You ship in weeks, not quarters, and you build, learn and iterate in parallel.

 You explain complex things simply , to a construction company's project manager as well as to internal stakeholders like our commercial teams or our management.

 You live AI. You use LLM assistants and MCPs every day, and you've built your own automations.

 You keep growing. You actively build your skills, and you seek and act on feedback.

 Fluent German and English. Our customers are German construction companies who work in German. Our engineering team works in English.

 Based in Germany and open to traveling to customers across the country.

 Bonus points if you've helped build an MCP server that customers use, or if you know construction tech, ERP or estimating systems (e.g. RIB iTWO, SAP, Nevaris).

 
 Why us?
 Real impact: You'll shape how an entire industry connects its software and how AI agents work with it.

 Competitive compensation: A salary above the market average.

 Work-life balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Germany, or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg, with flexible working hours.

 Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro.

 A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events.

 Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

 Growth & feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations with our Head of Product.
 

 About us
 Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.
  
 We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.
 Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avo

jobs.title: Product Owner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Crewmeister ist die führende Lösung zur Zeiterfassung und Schichtplanung von kleinen Unternehmen. Mit unserer Software unterstützen wir über 20.000 Kunden, das Stundenzettel-Chaos zu überwinden. Die Basis für unseren Erfolg sind unsere mehr als 60 Mitarbeitenden, die mit Herzblut, Neugier, Analytik und einer Menge Grips unsere Kunden mit unserem Produkt noch erfolgreicher machen.

 Bewirb dich dich bei uns als Product Owner , lerne von den Besten und mache unsere Erfolgsgeschichte zu deiner Erfolgsgeschichte.

 Dein Verantwortungsbereich: 

 Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase wirst du immer mehr zu einem wichtigen Treiber unserer Produktvision. Das bedeutet für uns:

 
 Du bist neugierig und bestrebt, die Bedürfnisse und Herausforderungen unserer Kunden zu verstehen und verfolgst unermüdlich die bestmögliche Lösung für sie.

 Du arbeitest eng mit dem Entwicklungsteam zusammen, um Produktideen in die Realität umzusetzen. Dabei beginnst du mit dem Verstehen der Anforderungen und bietest kontinuierliche Unterstützung während der Implementierung. So stellst du sicher, dass unser Team ein klares und umfassendes Verständnis des Projekts und der Kundenbedürfnisse hat.

 Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den Erfolg des Produkts: Gemeinsam mit dem Team erstellst du User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien, priorisierst Aufgaben und pflegst den Backlog. Dabei achtest du darauf, dass das Team an den wirklich wichtigen Dingen arbeitet.

 Du triffst datenbasierte Entscheidungen, um eine reibungslose Produktimplementierung sicherzustellen, und fungierst als wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen dem Produkt- und dem Entwicklungsteam.

 Du hältst dich stets über offene Fehlerberichte sowie die Herausforderungen der Kunden und Stakeholder auf dem Laufenden.

 Du arbeitest eng mit unserem aktuellen Product Owner und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um unsere Produkt-Roadmap zu verstehen und aktiv mitzugestalten.

 Du bist verantwortlich für die Releases unserer mobilen App(s).

 
 Erforderliche Qualifikationen:

 
 
 Du hast ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium oder Ähnliches.

 
 Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für Softwareentwicklung.

 
 Du hast 3-4 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Projektmanagement- oder Produktorganisation-Rolle.

 
 Du hast Erfahrung im DACH-Markt.

 
 Du hast Erfahrung mit einem Software- oder SaaS-Produkt.

 
 Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen in einem kleinen Unternehmen gesammelt.

 
 Du hast eine unerschöpfliche Neugier auf Technologie und das Verständnis der Benutzerbedürfnisse und strebst ständig nach Verbesserungen.

 
 Du bist mit agilen Werten sowie der Kanban- und Scrum-Methodik vertraut.

 
 Du hast Erfahrung im Schreiben von User Stories und im Aufteilen von Epics in nützliche Einheiten.

 
 Du bist schnell auf den Beinen und hast eine analytische, datengetriebene Denkweise.

 
 Du bringst ausgezeichnete Organisationsfähigkeiten und ein gutes Auge für Details mit.

 
 Du hast starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und sprichst fließend Englisch.

 
 Du sprichst sicher Deutsch (Niveau C1), da du auch mit Kunden interagieren wirst.

 
 Echte Verantwortung & große Freiheiten, um zusammen mit unserem internationalen Team einen bedeutenden Unterschied zu bewirken.

 
 Home-Office-Flexibilität: Maximiere deine Performance indem du von dort aus arbeitest, wo du am produktivsten bist.

 
 Modernes Office im Werksviertel Start-Up Hub, mit hauseigenen Barista.

 
 Coole Teamaktivitäten und Events

 
 Benefits wie: Essensgutscheine, JobRad, Fitnessstudio-Rabatte, Freikarten, MacBook, vergünstigtes Deutschlandticket

 
 Bei uns erhältst du nicht nur die Sicherheit eines finanzstarken Konzerns, sondern auch die Unternehmenskultur und Aufstiegschancen eines Start-ups.

 Bei Crewmeister geht es nicht nur um den Job, sondern um dich und dein Potenzial, um einen wirklichen Unterschied zu machen. Zeig uns, wer du bist – überzeuge uns mit deinem Lebenslauf und später im persönlichen Gespräch.

 Wir freuen uns darauf, dich vielleicht schon ganz bald in unserer Crew willkommen zu heißen!

jobs.title: Product Manager, Growth (Staff/Principal-level)
jobs.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 
 As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.
 Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.
 
 About the role 
 Synthesia ships more product, faster, than we ever have. AI has collapsed the cost of building which means the hard part is no longer making things, it’s making sure people actually adopt them. That’s the job of Growth, and we’re changing how we do it: instead of bolting Growth on after launch to optimise, we’re embedding a Growth PM into every core bet from day one, so how a product acquires, activates and scales is designed in from the first cycle.
 We’re hiring a Growth Product Manager to report to our VP of Growth. You'll own the Growth surface for one of those bets while helping build a growth-led way of working across the company.
 
 What you’ll be doing 
 Own Growth for a core product area end to end, acquisition, activation, adoption and retention, baked into the roadmap from the start, not retrofitted.

 Partner closely with the core product PMs and engineers who own the surface, bringing high-impact growth ideas and working out where they fit, and getting the primitives exposed that let you build and scale on top.

 Design growth into the product itself: discovery-led acquisition loops, and experiences that get users to their job-to-be-done in a couple of clicks (sometimes without opening the editor at all).

 Rally teams around specific, measurable outcomes and help each one hit its goal faster through what you build together.

 Work across engineering, marketing and GTM to make funnel- and journey-thinking a normal part of how we build.

 Who you are 
 AI-native. You’ve driven AI into how a product or team works - not just worked somewhere that does AI. You use it daily, you’re curious about how the stack works, and you keep up as it moves (fast).

 Scrappy and comfortable in ambiguity. You’ve taken something 0→1, you move fast, and you don’t need a clean brief or a stable roadmap to make progress. Constant change energises you rather than blocking you.

 A builder of credibility. You win trust across teams quickly and can get engineers, PMs and GTM aligned around growth - even when that’s a new way of working for them.

 Technically fluent and genuinely curious. You can hold your own with engineers on how things work and where the trade-offs are.

 Outcome-driven. You anchor on the right metric and move it.

 Requirements 
 Experience as a Product Manager with exposure to Growth. Depth in a single specific lever is a plus, not a prerequisite.

 Demonstrable experience driving AI-native product or ways of working.

 Comfortable in a fast-moving, 0→1, frequently-disrupted environment.

 Strong communication and the personality to build credibility and influence across functions.

 Technical fluency to partner credibly with engineering.

 Location
 Remote from Europe or hybrid based from our London or Munich offices. 
  
 Our culture
 At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here. 
  
 Global benefits:
 You will be compensated well with a generous salary and equity. 

 You get 25 days of annual leave + local holidays.

 Regular team offsites where you’ll get to collaborate with the product & engineering team in person. 

 Work from home budget 

 Work from anywhere policy of 60 days per year

 Generous referral scheme

 Enhanced parental leave - maternity leave includes 16 weeks at full pay, and paternity leave includes 5 weeks at full pay (if your country’s government scheme offers more generous support, you receive whichever is greater - our enhanced policy or the local statutory benefit)

  
 Benefits specific to UK: 
 Private healthcare via AXA for you with a discount for dependants

 5% pension match 

 Team lunches Tuesday-Friday in the office 

 Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office.

jobs.title: Self-Serve Product Manager - ElevenCreative
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs
 ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
 We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
 ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

 Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
 
 How we work
 High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 
 What we offer
 Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

 About the role
 We're hiring a Self-Serve PM to own the core ElevenCreative product experience for creators and marketers who sign up, subscribe, and build on their own. Self-serve users make up the majority of ElevenCreative's user base, and they use the platform to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
 You'll own self-serve revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That includes how users discover what ElevenCreative can do, how they move from a first generation into agents, video, and multi-step creative workflows, and what keeps them coming back and upgrading. There's no shortage of things we could build. The job is defining the big bets, scoping them well, and shipping them quickly with the team.
 PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward growth or go-to-market work, and you'll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for its users.

 Scope and define the big bets for the self-serve product across image, video, music, agents, and editing workflows

 Find the biggest opportunities in the user journey through product data and user behavior, and turn them into clearly scoped projects

 Drive adoption of newer experiences like agents and video, helping users expand from a single product into the full platform

 Work with engineering and design to ship quickly, mocking up early concepts yourself when it speeds things up

 Define success metrics for your area and track activation, engagement, retention, and conversion to paid plans

 Talk to creators and marketers regularly to understand how they work and where the product falls short, and bring those insights back to the team

 You bring strong technical depth, ideally in AI/ML, autonomy, robotics or another deep-tech domain, and can engage credibly with senior engineers and researchers.

jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance 

 Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
 
Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.
 The team 
 Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.
 We’re hiring a Product Manager with deep UX and interaction design expertise to build social experiences around investing and trading at Kraken.
 
You should be comfortable designing flows yourself, building interactive prototypes, and working through interaction details with designers and engineers. You’ll also own the product decisions: which customer problem to solve, what to ship first, and how to measure whether the experience improved.
  
 The opportunity 
 Design complete social journeys. Work through how someone discovers a person, decides to follow them, shares an idea or trade, receives a response, and returns. Connect these interactions into an experience users understand without explanation.

 Make the interaction details work. Shape navigation, information hierarchy, copy, defaults, gestures, and feedback. Specify what happens when a feed is empty, a post fails, content loads slowly, or someone changes their mind.

 Prototype before committing to a build. Turn ideas into interactive prototypes that communicate the intended behavior. Explore alternatives, test the uncertain parts, and give engineering clear flows, states, and acceptance criteria.

 Use psychology to improve participation. Understand why people hesitate to post, seek recognition, follow strangers, or respond to others. Translate those motivations into decisions about audience visibility, prompts, reputation, feedback, and the effort required to contribute.

 Observe users and fix what gets in their way. Run usability sessions, watch people complete tasks, and combine those observations with funnel data. Identify where people misunderstand the product, lose confidence, or abandon an action.

 Design for first use and repeated use. Make the experience useful before someone has connections. Keep sharing lightweight during an active trading session, with clear control over what becomes public. Test the twentieth interaction as carefully as the first.

 Connect design decisions to measurable outcomes. For each significant change, define the expected behavior and how to test it. Track task completion, abandonment, first follows, first contributions, responses, and subsequent retention. Work with data science to evaluate experiments and effects on both contributors and their audiences.

 Take the experience through launch. Choose a focused initial scope, resolve trade-offs with engineering, review the implementation against the intended design, and use post-launch evidence to decide what to improve next.

  
 What you bring 
 Has designed and shipped consumer social experiences. Your portfolio shows your contribution to feeds, profiles, sharing, messaging, discovery, or communities—and how the experience changed after launch.

 Has strong interaction design craft. You can explain why a flow is structured a particular way, what users will notice first, what they need to understand, and which decisions or steps can be removed.

 Can build realistic interactive prototypes. You use Figma, code, AI tools, or a combination to make behavior tangible and testable, including transitions, empty states, and failure states.

 Understands behavior through evidence. You can show where user research challenged your assumptions and changed a design.

 Can own product outcomes. You can prioritize a problem, define success, interpret funnel and cohort data, and explain whether an experiment produced a meaningful improvement.

 Understands the context of social finance. You account for how credibility, incentives, reputation, and visibility of financial activity affect what people trust and choose to share.

 Wait for work to fall on your desk - you’ll know what needs to be prioritised next .

 A company culture that really works

jobs.title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Description We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order. 

 Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

 Why join us? Picture this: 
 Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.
 Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.
 Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.
 An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.
 Still unsure about why joining us? 
 You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.
 From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.
 Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.
 You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.
 Let’s make the invisible visible! 

 What will you do Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements.
 Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months.
 Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team.
 Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements.
 For each requirement, define acceptance criteria from the customer's point of view so it is clear and testable when the need is met, and link them to customer evaluation and qualification plans.
 Align with the Product Development department on scope and timing, and hand solution-neutral requirements into engineering: state the need and the why, and leave the how to the disciplines.
 Support go-to-market: give input on positioning, pricing, launch readiness, and documentation scope together with the applications, operations, and product development teams.
 

 What is expected of you Several years in product management for complex hardware or capital equipment, ideally in semiconductor, metrology, or a comparable deep-tech environment.
 A track record of writing clear product requirements that engineering can actually build from.
 The ability to talk to both customers and engineers and to translate between them.
 Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with the people designing the product, across mechanics, optics, electronics/RF, and software.
 Structured prioritization: you make trade-offs explicit and back them with reasoning.
 We hire for demonstrated skill rather than a specific degree; a technical or scientific background is typical. The working language is English.
 Additional experience we value: 
 Semiconductor industry knowledge (fabs, IDMs, OSATs, inspection, metrology, or failure analysis).
 Familiarity with SEMI standards and fab tool integration (for example, S2/S8, E10, SECS/GEM).
 Experience selecting or setting up a requirements management tool (for example, Jama, Polarion, or CodeBeamer).
 A working understanding of quantum sensing, optics, or precision instrumentation.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Quantum Research
jobs.description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions 
 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager – Advanced Technology Programs to lead large-scale, strategic technology and R&D programs involving multiple technical disciplines, internal teams and external partners.
 You will operate at the intersection of technology, engineering and program execution , turning ambitious technical objectives into structured and executable programs.
 You will coordinate programs involving disciplines such as quantum physics, integrated photonics, semiconductor technologies, electronics, optics, hardware engineering, software and algorithms , while ensuring alignment between technical performance, schedule, resources, budget and contractual commitments.
 We are particularly interested in candidates who have managed large and technically complex programs in demanding engineering environments such as space, aerospace, defense or semiconductors , where successful delivery requires coordinating multidisciplinary teams, suppliers, industrial partners, research organizations and institutional stakeholders across several countries.
 This is a senior individual contributor / program leadership position requiring both technical credibility and strong execution capabilities . You will not be expected to be the scientific expert on every topic, but you must be able to understand complex technical dependencies, challenge assumptions, structure decisions and create the conditions for engineering teams to deliver.
 
 Key responsabilities 
 
 ** Lead Complex Technology Projects 
 Take end-to-end ownership of strategic R&D and technology projects, from initial framing through development, integration, validation and final delivery.
 Translate high-level scientific, product or business ambitions into clear program objectives, work packages, milestones, interfaces and measurable deliverables .
 Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering scope, schedule, resources, budget, dependencies and critical paths.
 Establish program governance and ensure effective decision-making across technical teams and senior stakeholders.
 Monitor progress against milestones and proactively identify deviations, bottlenecks and dependencies requiring management attention.
 Drive recovery plans when projects deviate from their original objectives, including prioritization, resource reallocation, scope adjustment or technical replanning.
 
 ** Manage Technical complexity & interfaces 
 Coordinate multidisciplinary teams spanning quantum physics, photonics, semiconductor technologies, optics, electronics, mechanical engineering, systems engineering, software and algorithms .
 Work closely with technical leads to identify critical interfaces and dependencies between subsystems and workstreams.
 Challenge project assumptions and ensure that technical decisions are translated into clear consequences for performance, schedule, cost and risk .
 Support the transition from research and scientific proof-of-concept to engineering development, prototyping, integration, qualification and demonstrators .
 Ensure that technical maturity, integration readiness and project risks are visible and understood at program level.
 
 * * Coordinate Internal & External Stakeholders 
 Act as a central coordination point between Quandela teams, industrial partners, suppliers, research institutions and institutional stakeholders.
 Lead technical and programmatic exchanges involving stakeholders with different scientific, engineering and business perspectives.
 Coordinate activities across multiple teams, organizations, sites and countries , ensuring clear ownership and effective information flow.
 Manage expectations and commitments with external partners while protecting Quandela's technical, contractual and strategic interests.
 Prepare and lead program reviews, steering committees and executive-level project updates.
 
 ** Risk, Budget & Delivery Management 
 Establish and maintain structured risk and opportunity management , including technical, schedule, supply-chain, financial and organizational risks.
 Own or contribute to program budgets, resource forecasts and capacity plan

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager (m/f/d - Remote)
jobs.description:
Weflow's Revenue AI Platform automates Salesforce data capture and gives full visibility into deal, pipeline, and forecast health. 300+ fast-growing companies like Retool, Abridge, and IDnow use Weflow to improve team productivity, sales performance, and revenue predictability.

 Weflow is backed by Gradient Ventures, Cherry Ventures, Eurazeo, and renowned angel investors, and run by repeat founders Philipp Stelzer and Janis Zech.

 Tasks

 We’re rebranding and rethinking how we show up, what we stand for, and how we explain what Weflow actually does. That makes this a rare moment to join.

 You’d help us build our brand from the ground up, then carry it through everything buyers touch: the website, the product story, the resources that help them decide.

 You’d be our first and only product marketer. Which means real ownership of positioning, messaging, the website and the product narrative.

 Your role:

 
 Own our positioning and messaging. Shape it through the rebrand with the founders and Head of Growth, then make it real everywhere it shows up.

 Own our website as a product marketing surface: structure, copy, conversion, and how the story unfolds across pages.

 Tie brand, website and resource hub together so they compound instead of sitting in silos. Build the product marketing library that helps buyers evaluate us: how-to videos, walkthroughs, comparison pages, sales collateral.

 Lead go-to-market for new features and releases.

 Keep our positioning grounded in reality: talk to customers, run win/loss, and track what competitors are claiming.

 Give GTM the messaging foundations they work from, so we tell one consistent story.

 Work with GTM, product, and design to inject our product story.

 
 Requirements

 
 3+ years in product marketing at a B2B SaaS company, ideally selling to technical or operations buyers.

 Exceptional writing. Clear, specific, no filler. You can explain a technical product without dumbing it down or hiding behind jargon.

 Positioning instincts. You work out what a product really is, not just what the roadmap says.

 You’re comfortable owning a website end to end: structure, copy, shipping changes.

 You want to be the one who owns this, not one of five people with an opinion on it.

 You think Product Marketing beyond the website-

 Fluent English

 Experience in RevOps, sales tech or CRM-adjacent categories is a plus.

 
 Benefits

 
 A remote-first company

 Regular in-person meetups

 Top-of-the-line equipment

 An experienced, distributed and diverse team

 A competitive package, including stock options

 
 We look forward to hearing from you! We value diversity of perspective and seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all backgrounds.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 
 Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 
 Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 
 To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 
 BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 
 Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 
 
 
 Location 
 This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.
 Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.
 
 Your Mission 
 You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.
 As a Senior Project Manager , you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.
 At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.
 You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.
 We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.
 
 Your Career Path in Project Management 
 This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.
 Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management. 

 Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs. 

 Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

 Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

 Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

 Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

 Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

 Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

 Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

 Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

 In addition, as a Senior Project Manager 
 Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

 Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

jobs.description:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense.
